name: His Own Being
source:
It's 2020. At the height of COVID lockdowns, a young gay man dreams nightly of love, only to wake up alone. Desperate, he cries out, and receives an answer—in a perfect double of himself.

[From [url=https://davisgsee.itch.io/his-own-being]itch.io[/url]]
